purpose: Close bootstrap continuity without falsely declaring every historical artifact semantically or scientifically revalidated.

INDEXED_EXPLICIT.definition: Artifact is itself part of the continuity spine or is explicitly referenced by a spine artifact.
INDEXED_EXPLICIT.authority_effect: None by class alone; exact current scientific authority is still determined by CURRENT_STATE, authority ledgers, prereg/result/source and explicit promotion/retraction.

FIT1_COMMIT_LEDGER_COVERED.definition: Artifact was introduced or changed in history descended from the FIT1 gate anchor and the exact change is recoverable through canonical/FIT1_COMMIT_LINEAGE_V1.json.
FIT1_COMMIT_LEDGER_COVERED.authority_effect: Discovery/provenance only. A commit message or changed file does not establish execution, PASS, promotion or generalization.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_ACCEPTED_RESIDUAL.definition: High-signal artifact already existed at the FIT1 gate anchor and is retained as historical evidence/provenance unless separately indexed/promoted.
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_ACCEPTED_RESIDUAL.authority_effect: Historical/evidence-only by default. It cannot outrank current canonical state merely because it is detailed, newer-looking, or still tracked.

UNEXPLAINED.definition: High-signal artifact is neither explicitly indexed, FIT1-ledger-covered, nor present at the FIT1 gate anchor.
UNEXPLAINED.authority_effect: Continuity regression. Forbidden after bootstrap closure; CI must fail closed.

mandatory_scientific_corrections_preserv.rule: Authoritative staircase is R2 FAIL -> C1 full-surface cross-attention PASS -> STOP. C2 conditional diffusion was implemented but not authoritatively run in that staircase. C3/C4 remain fuller source-coded research mechanisms without authoritative full-formulation closure.

Both AR0 and AR1 completed to 16384; neither satisfied terminal 48-check stability. AR0 capacity/reachability is strong but terminal stability unresolved. AR1 teacher-forced closure with free-running failure is exposure/recurrent-error-amplification evidence. No causal winner/refreeze/full-RigAnything verdict.

Affected historical learned IRIS V2 checkpoints/metrics are quarantined for clean observation-only claims. Firewall repair closes the source seam prospectively; it does not retroactively cleanse quarantined learned results.

IRIS/Geppetto/Arachne are learned evidence/proposal owners inside deterministic qualification envelopes. Compiler/GSA may analytically assemble, constrain legality and fail close; they may not silently invent missing learned semantics or convert repaired output into model success.

branch_policy.rule: Branch existence/recency never implies scientific or continuation authority. Evidence branches are retained unless explicitly disposed; no automatic deletion is authorized by AOA closure.

closure_nonclaims: AOA closure does not validate every historical result.
AOA closure does not promote historical branch code.
AOA closure does not convert implemented mechanisms into executed mechanisms.
AOA closure does not prove FIT1 or unseen-family generalization.
AOA closure does not authorize a new Geppetto experiment/refreeze or Arachne training by itself.
